claimedSlice: opencv2/cudafilters.hpp parser-backed CUDA image-filter declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaFilters wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudafilters module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS/WinRT; real filtering depends on an external CUDA toolkit/runtime and NPP image-filter libraries.
The module requires opencv_imgproc and opencv_cudaarithm plus GpuMat/Stream data, asynchronous execution policy, and persistent filter state; this package ships no CUDA image-filter wrapper/runtime.

declarations.reason: Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.

The CUDA image-filter surface in cv::cuda has no native CudaFilters wrapper entrypoint or managed public owner in the current package; OpenCV disables the module on iOS/WinRT and unless CUDA or CUDA stubs are enabled, while real filtering requires CUDA/NPP and the upstream imgproc/cudaarithm dependency chain. GpuMat/Stream ownership, asynchronous execution, and filter state remain outside the current ABI/API and deterministic smoke contract.
